stem: The mean of the daily sales, in thousands of dollars, at a bookshop over 5 days was 18. If the day with the greatest sales is excluded, the mean of the other 4 days is 15. If instead the day with the least sales is excluded, the mean of the other 4 days is 20. What is the range, in thousands of dollars, of the daily sales over the 5 days?
solution: Greatest daily sales: \(90 - 4 \times 15 = 30\). Least daily sales: \(90 - 4 \times 20 = 10\).
verify:
tot = 5 * 18
mx = tot - 4 * 15
mn = tot - 4 * 20
assert (mx, mn) == (30, 10)
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [mx - mn] == [20]
